events.name: China Open — WTA 1000
events.selectedSentence: Beijing puts Rybakina, Sabalenka, Gauff and Andreeva on four separate paths through a deep draw.
events.fullSpiel: The early rounds are about earning the marquee meetings, not assuming them. Gauff and Swiatek share a quarter, while Andreeva could run into Noskova and Sabalenka has Osaka in her section. Those are possible later matchups, not booked fixtures. With a 96-player singles field, the first weekend tests who can turn a favourable seed into a sustained run.
